title: "Evidence to be Verified on the Spot"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the informant collapsed in fear, a violent Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came from outside the council hall—the intensity of that aura far exceeded anyone present. From the depths of the sect, a greater enemy was approaching."

text.content: "The atmosphere in the council hall was heavy as lead. All eyes were drawn to the purple light descending from the heavens. The messenger of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path stepped through the void, and the demonic energy surrounding her caused the spirit lamps in the hall to dim. Yet just as everyone held their breath, the Fifth Elder, who was presiding over the ceremony, had no choice but to press on—the Evidence Verification Ritual had already begun, and stopping midway would be a desecration of sect rules."

dialogue.content: "'Since the honored messenger has traveled far, please rest in the high pavilion.' Old Sect Master Ling Yuan's expression remained unchanged. He gestured for the golden-robed disciples in attendance to guide the Demonic Path messenger to her seat. 'This old man has urgent sect matters to attend to. Please wait a moment.' His voice was neither servile nor haughty, yet it carried an undeniable authority."

text.content: "The purple-robed messenger's lips curved into an amused arc. She did not take the seat, instead standing with hands clasped behind her at the hall's side. Those deep, dark eyes swept over Chen Ji, who was being held in the hall, wearing an expression between a smile and a sneer. 'No matter. This one has come precisely for this case—I hear the Tianqing Sect intends to execute a traitor who colluded with the Demonic Path. I must see who dares to act in our Holy Sect's name.' This statement seemed to distance herself, but hidden within were barbs, causing the Fifth Elder's temples to bead with sweat."

dialogue.content: "'Fifth Elder, since the three sect envoys and the honored guest have all arrived, please present the so-called evidence.' Ling Yuan's voice was unhurried. 'Today we shall verify the truth before all the gathered guests, so that certain ill-intentioned persons may be convinced.' His gaze flickered almost imperceptibly toward Chen Ji—that brief flash of coldness vanished in an instant."

text.content: "The Fifth Elder drew a deep breath and withdrew a yellowed letter and a Spiritual Jade Slip from his sleeve, holding them high above his head. 'These are the items submitted by the informant—a letter detailing Chen Ji's secret dealings with the Demonic Path, and a Jade Slip containing evidence of Chen Ji secretly harboring forbidden spiritual patterns. Material evidence is complete. May the Elders' Council examine them!' He spoke at breakneck speed, as if afraid of complications."

"Chen Ji knelt in the hall's center, his back hunched, his expression panicked—a perfect picture of a startled bird on a frayed string. Yet the instant the Fifth Elder unfolded the letter, a faint gleam flickered in the depths of those downcast eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment quivered within his soul, seemingly transmitting some message—the spiritual residue on that paper was completely different from the spiritual energy pattern it claimed to record as Chen Ji's own."

dialogue.content: "'Hah, this trash acts more cowardly than anyone, but privately he's quite good at making excuses.' Han Lie stood at the hall's side with arms crossed, a mocking smile playing on his lips. 'Elders, examine carefully. Don't let one rotten apple spoil the whole barrel. The Xuanwu Sect's reputation cannot be tarnished by this kind of person!' He spoke with great righteousness, but within his eyes flashed anticipation—the desire to see Chen Ji condemned on the spot, forever unable to rise."

text.content: "The Fifth Elder handed the letter toward the Elders' seats and was about to read its contents when Chen Ji suddenly let out a weak cough. 'Cough... Esteemed Elders, this disciple has a matter of confusion and dares to ask—' His voice was hoarse and trembling. 'Since this letter claims to be written by this disciple, may this Elder allow this disciple to... personally examine the handwriting?' He spoke with extreme caution, as if fearing to offend anyone."

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his gaze sweeping between Chen Ji and the Fifth Elder. After a moment, he淡淡道 said: 'Granted.' The single word fell, and the Fifth Elder's face whitened several shades. He forced himself to remain composed, handing the letter to Chen Ji. 'Examine carefully. Do not speak recklessly.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji extended those calloused hands and received the letter. He hunched closer to examine it, his fingertips brushing across the paper's surface—movements slow and clumsy. Yet deep within his soul, the Tianji Record Fragment was operating at full speed—the spiritual residue on the paper clearly told him: the writer's spiritual attribute differed from Chen Ji's own by at least three levels. This was definitely not written by him."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji sees through the forgery and now must choose how to expose the truth"

choices.description: "Publicly point out the fabricated evidence, leaving no room for mercy"
choices.risk_hint: "May alert the mastermind behind the scenes"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, and a flash of sharpness appeared in those previously dull eyes. He gently folded the letter and spoke in a voice neither high nor low, yet it clearly carried across the entire hall: 'Reporting to the Elders, this letter... was not written by this disciple.'"

choices.description: "First appear weak to draw out more flaws, then expose everything at once"
choices.visible_reward: "Expose the mastermind along with everything else"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji deliberately wore a timid expression, handing the letter back with trembling hands. 'Elder, please forgive me. This disciple... truly does not remember writing this letter. However, this handwriting somewhat resembles... someone...' He trailed off meaningfully, yet his gaze flickered toward the Fifth Elder."

choices.text: "Borrow the power of the Demonic Path messenger"
choices.description: "Utilize the Demonic Path messenger's presence to introduce third-party verification"
choices.visible_reward: "The messenger takes the initiative to expose the truth"
choices.risk_hint: "May expose a relationship with the Demonic Path"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly bowed deeply toward the purple-robed messenger at the hall's side. 'This disciple dares to ask—since the honored messenger has traveled from afar, surely you are skilled in spiritual authentication. This disciple stakes his life that this letter was not written by him. Might the messenger provide guidance?' His posture was the picture of humility."

text.content: "The hall fell silent in an instant. The muscles on the Fifth Elder's face twitched slightly, yet he forced himself to remain composed. 'Ridiculous! You, a servant disciple, dare question the informant's sincerity? This letter was delivered to the Elders' Hall by a designated person, with intact seal. Where is the forgery?' His voice rose several notches, the picture of bluster hiding inner panic."

"Yet Chen Ji unhurriedly unfolded the letter, pointing to one of the ink marks with his fingertip. His voice remained soft. 'Elder, please examine. This disciple, since childhood poor, learned to write using ordinary pine-soot ink, therefore when writing he习惯将 the character '的' as a simplified stroke and horizontal... ' He paused, surveying the surroundings. 'But on this letter, the character '的' is written in the standard cabinet style, with meticulous strokes. May I ask the Elder—if this disciple possessed such calligraphy skill, why would he be a servant in the sect for ten years?'"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie frowned and coldly snorted. 'Insignificant trick! Handwriting can be imitated. What kind of evidence is that?' He strode forward, looming over Chen Ji. 'You trash, aren't you just panicking and making wild accusations?'"

choice.prompt: "Han Lie questions the insufficiency of evidence. Chen Ji must further prove his case"

choices.description: "Use the spiritual difference detected by the Tianji Record as ironclad proof"
choices.visible_cost: "Consume a small amount of Heavenly Fate"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji raised his head and met Han Lie's dismissive gaze directly. His voice suddenly became exceptionally calm. 'Han Shixiong speaks truly—handwriting can be imitated... then what about spiritual aura?' He slowly stood, straightening his back for the first time before everyone. 'The writer's spiritual attribute is completely different from this disciple's own—a fact no disguise can conceal.'"

choices.description: "Have the three arranged outer disciples testify in person"
choices.visible_reward: "Witnesses and material evidence form a complete chain"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly called toward the hall entrance at full volume. 'Since Han Shixiong demands ironclad evidence, this disciple requests witnesses—the three outer disciples who were on duty at the scripture repository with this disciple that day. They personally saw that this disciple never left for a moment, and could not have交接 any letter!'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan's gaze sharpened instantly. The crafty old man immediately realized the severity of the situation—if Chen Ji's words were true, then today's matter would not merely be falsely accusing a servant disciple, but rather a deliberate deception staged under the very noses of the Elders' Council. He said in a low voice: 'Summon—the three witnesses to the hall!'"

"A moment later, three trembling outer disciples were brought into the hall. The leading young man with the surname Zhou knelt and saluted, his forehead pressed against the cold stone floor, yet his voice was exceptionally clear. 'Disciple Zhou Changsheng was on duty at the scripture repository with Chen Shixiong that day, from morning until sunset. Chen Shixiong never left for a moment! This disciple stakes his life on this testimony. If there is any falsehood, may thunder strike me down!'"

dialogue.content: "The other two disciples also kowtowed repeatedly, confirming Zhou Changsheng's words. The Fifth Elder's face had already turned as white as paper, large beads of sweat rolling down his forehead. He furiously turned to glare toward the informant, only to find that person already ashen-faced, legs weak, barely able to stand."

text.content: "Chen Ji still maintained that timid posture, slowly turning toward the informant. He asked softly, 'This Shixiong, you accuse me of colluding with the Demonic Path. May I ask—when, where, and by what means did you make contact with me? If such a thing truly happened, why did none of the three Shidi see any suspicious person?' His voice was calm to the point of gentleness, yet each word was like a blade."

dialogue.content: "The informant's lips trembled, unable to form a single word for a long while. Han Lie's expression also became extremely unsightly. He never expected that this trash he had never looked down upon would have the ability to turn a certain victory into such a mess."

text.content: "Chen Ji turned once more toward the Fifth Elder, hunching his back. 'Elder, this disciple dares to ask one more question—the letter arrived that day, the seal was intact. This disciple would like to ask, which Shixiong possesses such remarkable ability to swap the letter while the seal remained intact?' His tone was the ultimate in humility, yet its implications made the Fifth Elder feel as though he had fallen into an icy abyss."

dialogue.content: "The Fifth Elder shuddered all over, lips quivering but unable to produce a sound. Ling Yuan's gaze fell upon him like a blade, his voice cold with not a trace of warmth. 'Fifth Elder, this seat is asking you directly. How much do you truly know about this matter of accusation?'"

choice.prompt: "The truth is about to be revealed. The Fifth Elder is driven into a corner"

choices.description: "Point out the Fifth Elder as the mastermind behind the scenes"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes meeting the Fifth Elder's for the first time. His voice remained steady. 'This disciple would not dare to speculate wildly. I merely recall one thing—the day the accusation letter arrived, the Elder happened to be patrolling near the scripture repository. Coincidence, or... something else amiss?'"

choices.description: "Don't expose directly, give the Fifth Elder a way out"
choices.visible_cost: "Cannot pursue the mastermind behind the scenes"

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and lowered his head again, his voice returning to its previous timidity. 'This disciple dares not speak further. Everything shall be decided by the Elders' Council.' With that, he slowly retreated to his original position and knelt, as if those brilliant analyses had never come from his mouth."

"Dead silence filled the hall. The Fifth Elder's face was ashen, lips quivering as he tried to defend himself, but not a single word emerged. The informant had collapsed to the ground, trembling violently. Ling Yuan's gaze swept over the two like an eagle's, the coldness in those eyes making everyone present shiver."

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan's voice descended from the high platform, devoid of any emotion. 'Guards, take the informant and related persons into custody for detailed questioning. As for the Fifth Elder—' He paused. 'This matter is fraught with suspicious points. You cannot escape responsibility. Temporarily strip yourself of Elder rank and await judgment.'"

text.content: "The Fifth Elder was struck like thunder. His entire body went limp and was dragged out of the hall by two law enforcement disciples. Just before passing through the door, he glanced back at Chen Ji—that look of venom nearly transforming into physical substance. Yet Chen Ji remained docile and compliant, as if seeing nothing at all. Only he himself knew: this debt, he had recorded."

"The Demonic Path messenger at the hall's side let out a low laugh—clear, cold, and amused. 'Interesting. The Tianqing Sect's 'trash' has given this one a new perspective.' Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, and within those deep purple eyes flickered a meaningful light—like gazing upon a piece about to mature on the chessboard."

"Chen Ji knelt in the hall with head bowed, back still hunched, expression still timid. Yet at this moment, no one in the great hall dared to look down upon this servant disciple who had been mocked for ten years. The three outer disciples gazed at him with admiration, Han Lie's face was livid, Ling Yuan's gaze was deep as an abyss—and those who had once bullied him all unconsciously stepped back half a pace."

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his voice carrying not a trace of emotion. 'Chen Ji, though you have cleared yourself of suspicion, the speed of this exposure and the depth of its connections exceed all expectations.' His gaze was as deep as an ancient well. 'This seat gives you three days to investigate and find the mastermind. Otherwise—' He did not finish, yet that unfinished implication caused the hall's temperature to drop another three degrees."

text.content: "Chen Ji prostrated in salute, his voice humble. 'This disciple obeys.' He slowly straightened up, but the instant he rose, his gaze swept across the gloomy sky outside the hall. The Tianji Record Fragment within his soul trembled slightly, transmitting a vague warning—as if some extremely dangerous existence was approaching."

"Just then, a violent Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came from outside the hall. That aura was violent and bizarre, carrying an nauseating scent of blood that instantly enveloped the entire council hall. The purple-robed messenger frowned, and a solemn glint flickered in those deep purple eyes. 'This aura... how interesting.'"

"Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, alarm bells ringing in his heart. The Tianji Record Fragment within his soul vibrated frantically, the foresight it transmitted blurry and chaotic—countless fragmented images flashed through his spirit sea, yet all became obscure and unclear because of a certain key individual's presence. He knew—the person he had searched for all these years... was within that approaching aura."

"The hall doors burst open, and a blood-red figure strode through the void. She was a young woman, surrounded by bizarre blood-colored runes, her features bearing three points of resemblance to Chen Ji, yet her eyes were terrifyingly hollow. Chen Ji trembled violently; at that moment, the trash persona he had maintained for ten years nearly shattered—because that woman was his missing sister, Chen Nian."
